blurb: This lovely log house began life on the Zion Line as a Methodist Church in about 1865, but in 1913 was moved to land originally owned by the Township founder, James Ross, on the south shore of Muskrat Lake, where it was re-purposed as a comfortable home by the Code Family. It was moved to Forester’s Falls in 1995, and was the impetus for the founding of our museum.
